items.title: Enterprise Sales Manager
items.location_text: New York City, San Francisco, Austin
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE As an Enterprise Sales Manager at Perplexity, you'll lead a team of Account Executives selling Perplexity Enterprise and Computer to Enterprise accounts. You'll be responsible for hiring and ramping the team, coaching sellers through complex enterprise sales cycles, and owning team revenue targets. RESPONSIBILITIES - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives, providing regular feedback to drive individual and team performance - Own team revenue targets, with accountability for pipeline creation, deal execution, and forecast accuracy - Hire, onboard, and ramp new Account Executives in partnership with Recruiting and Enablement - Coach the team on outbound prospecting, account planning, and converting existing self-serve customers into Enterprise relationships - Support AEs in complex, multi-stakeholder deals, including executive alignment, technical evaluation, security review, and negotiation - Run a regular cadence of 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and deal reviews, maintaining accurate Salesforce data and forecasts - Partner with Enablement, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and RevOps to translate field feedback into action YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF - 7+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with 3+ years directly managing quota-carrying Account Executives - A track record of meeting or exceeding team revenue targets in a high-growth environment - Experience hiring, ramping, and developing sellers - Experience coaching teams to generate their own pipeline through outbound and account-based prospecting - Strong command of Salesforce, pipeline management, and forecasting - Background selling technical products, ideally AI, data, or infrastructure - Comfort operating without an established playbook

items.title: Account Manager - Corporate
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE You will own the full commercial relationship and customer’s success across a book of 100 to 200 corporate accounts - the builders, founders, and product teams at companies up to 250 employees who are defining what AI-native experiences look, feel, and sound like. Your job is to make sure every one of them is getting real value, expanding into new products, and renewing with conviction. This is a high-volume, high-impact role. You won't succeed by managing accounts one at a time - you'll build the systems, playbooks, and scaled motions that let you drive meaningful outcomes across a diverse book. If you love the challenge of figuring out how to operate at scale without losing the quality of the customer relationship, this role was built for you. On the ground, you'll be in the product with customers - advising on agent design, voice customization, conversation flows, integrations, and using data and logs to spot friction before customers do. You're the person who connects what's working technically to what's growing commercially and partnering closely with high growth accounts to help them achieve value. Success of the customer and commercial ownership go hand in hand and are at the core of this role. You own NRR across your managed book of business, you drive cross-sell into ElevenLabs’ expanding product suite, and you lead renewals end to end. The best AMs at ElevenLabs don’t just retain customers, they grow with them. COMPENSATION This role offers a competitive on target earnings (OTE) structure with a split of 70% base and 30% variable. Variable compensation is weighted 100% net revenue retention (NRR) with an emphasis on product cross sell. Cross-sell performance counts toward NRR, so strong expansion compounds across both components. Quota is set on managed ARR, giving you clear ownership over a defined book of business. The plan includes accelerators for above target NRR performance and is designed to reward account managers who grow with their customers, not just retain them. Variable compensation is paid on a quarterly basis. REQUIREMENTS - Minimum 2 years of Account Management or Customer Success experience in B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products - you know what good looks like in a technical, fast-moving customer environment - A track record of owning commercial outcomes: quota, renewals, cross-sell, and the full expansion motion from identifying the opportunity to closing it - Comfortable managing a high-volume book of business with a systems mindset - you build playbooks and repeatable motions, not just individual relationships - Hands-on familiarity with AI concepts, API integrations, and SDKs; you can hold a technical conversation with a developer or engineering team and earn their trust - Experience using product usage data to stay ahead of your accounts - spotting health signals, identifying expansion opportunities, and getting in front of risk before it becomes churn - Strong communicator who can move fluidly between a founder, a technical lead, and a procurement team in the same week Preferred - Experience in the voice AI, audio AI, or conversational AI space - Experience selling or expanding into multiple products within a platform LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in ET, CT, MT, or PT timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York City or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our offices in these cities. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Supplier Partnerships Manager - Betting Content
items.description: We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. ABOUT US: The Marketplace is a key part of how we expand the breadth and quality of betting content available to our customers. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the supplier ecosystem, influence commercial strategy, and build partnerships that directly contribute to the growth of the platform. THE ROLE: You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to work across commercial, product, technology, and operational teams in a genuinely international environment We’re looking for a Supplier Partnerships Manager to help grow and mature the supply side of our Marketplace - a platform that enables third-party betting content to be made available to the sports betting industry. This role sits at the intersection of commercial partnerships, supplier onboarding, and lifecycle management . You’ll identify and secure high-value suppliers, lead commercial negotiations, oversee onboarding and integration activities, and become the ongoing commercial and relationship owner for your supplier portfolio. THE CHALLENGE: Working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Commercial teams, you’ll ensure suppliers integrate successfully, meet agreed performance standards, and deliver sustainable value to our customers and the wider Marketplace. This is a high-impact opportunity for a commercially minded partnerships professional who combines strong relationship-building skills with an understanding of technology-driven products, data, and digital platforms . Key Responsibilities: Source and develop new supplier partnerships: Identify, qualify, and engage potential suppliers aligned with Marketplace strategy, customer demand, and commercial priorities. Own the commercial process: Lead supplier discussions from initial outreach and qualification through negotiation, commercial agreement, and contract signature. Drive supplier onboarding: Coordinate due diligence, onboarding, and integration activities with Product, Engineering, Legal, and other internal stakeholders to ensure suppliers are brought live efficiently. Manage the supplier lifecycle: Build trusted, long-term relationships with suppliers, establish clear expectations, and proactively manage performance, engagement, and commercial development. Monitor performance and compliance: Track supplier performance against contractual, commercial, and SLA commitments, identifying risks and opportunities for improvement. Identify growth opportunities: Use usage, revenue, and performance data to provide suppliers with actionable insights and identify opportunities to increase adoption and commercial value. Own supplier escalations: Act as the primary commercial escalation point for supplier issues, working cross-functionally to resolve blockers and maintain strong relationships. Bring market insight: Provide Product and Commercial teams with market intelligence, competitive insights, and assessments of supplier capabilities, positioning, and relevance. Manage the supplier pipeline: Track and report on KPIs including supplier pipeline, activation, integration progress, performance, and revenue contribution. Shape supplier strategy: Contribute to the Marketplace supplier strategy, prioritisation, and roadmap, ensuring supplier investments support broader business and customer objectives. ABOUT YOU: 5–8 years of experience in partnerships, business development, supplier management, or commercial roles, ideally within B2B technology, betting, sports, media, data, or digital platforms. A proven track record of negotiating and managing high-value commercial partnerships from initial engagement through contract execution and ongoing relationship management. Strong understanding of data and content products, APIs, integrations, or digital platform ecosystems . Excellent relationship-management skills, with the ability to build credibility and trust with strategic partners and senior stakeholders. Strong commercial judgement and the ability to identify opportunities, assess trade-offs, and turn partnerships into measurable business value. Confident communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence both internal and external stakeholders. A structured, organised approach and the ability to manage multiple supplier relationships, negotiations, and onboarding processes simultaneously. An analytical mindset, with the ability to use performance and market data to evaluate suppliers and inform commercial decisions. Experience in sports data, betting content, media rights, or marketplace ecosystems is highly desirable. Comfortable operating in a cross-functional, technology-driven environment where priorities can evolve quickly. OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Engineering offices in Europe, Asia and US) Ability to shape your own workday and career via a clearly defined professional and personal development plan Opportunity to work with senior leadership, develop yourself and build your career within an inspiring and fast-growing company and digital sports environment. A vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants A company culture that promotes social aspects, sports, physical exercise and fun. Innovative and cross-team challenges like ShipIt, office sports tournaments in Darts and Table Tennis and unique beer brewing competitions. Competitive salary and benefits (e.g. retirement pension and insurance plan) Sportradar takes over the full costs of € 365.- for the Öffi-Ticket (Jahreskarte) for you OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. 1st Interview: 60-minute conversation with the Hiring Manager to discuss your experience and expertise. The interview will also include a problem-solving element to understand your approach to leading partnerships end-to-end. Final Interview: 45–60-minute conversation focused on your strategic thinking and cultural alignment with the organization. Final Steps: Receive final feedback while onsite visit might be requested and, if successful, an offer! We believe great products are built by great teams working closely together. While we offer flexible working hours, this role is fully office-based, as we strongly value in-person collaboration, knowledge sharing, fast decision-making, and team connection. We see working together onsite as a key driver of innovation, learning, and success. Certain exemptions may apply depending on location - your local point of contact can provide further details. The minimum monthly salary for this position is according to the Collective Bargaining Agreement. Overpayment will be considered depending on qualifications and working experience. At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

items.title: Chief of Staff, Strategic Growth & Partnerships (UK)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team We are seeking a strategic, highly commercial and growth-driven Chief of Staff to spearhead commercial expansion and high-priority strategic initiatives in the UK market. Sitting directly alongside the UK CEO, this role bridges establishing high-value institutional partnerships with executive-level project execution. This is a high-leverage commercial and sales-focused Chief of Staff role - not an internal, project management or administration-focused role. Moving beyond traditional sales or purely operational roles, this position is designed for a strategic partner. You will act as the UK CEO’s right hand contributing to the long-term strategy, originating institutional partnerships and owning cross-functional strategic projects with the CEO end-to-end. A core element of this role is driving commercial growth alongside the UK CEO. This includes fully grasping the broader landscape, market and competitor dynamics, customer behaviour and regulatory context into actionable strategies for Group-level product and executive leadership. Your Responsibilities Strategic Business Development & Commercial Growth Market & Commercial Strategy: Act as the local market strategist, translating UK client context, competitive dynamics, and customer feedback into growth opportunities and clear requirements for leadership. Execute on this Strategy and Drive Partner Origination & Platform Growth: Lead business development initiatives to identify and execute commercial partnerships with banks, asset managers, wealth managers and myriad financial institutions across the UK. Executive Sales Support: Partner directly with the UK CEO on complex commercial partnership negotiations. Deal Structuring & Financial Modeling: Evaluate commercial frameworks, conduct quantitative modeling, and negotiate terms for strategic accounts and commercial initiatives. Strategic Operations & Cross-Functional Execution Strategic Project Management: Own and drive end-to-end execution of CEO-led strategic initiatives, ensuring cross-functional alignment across local teams and the wider Raisin Group. Executive & Board Preparation: Draft strategic presentations, business cases, and commercial proposals for the UK CEO, Boards (local and Group), and Group executive management. Product Roadmap Alignment: Collaborate with Group product and operational teams to champion UK commercial priorities and integrate required features into the product roadmap. Structured Execution: Maintain rigorous documentation, project cadences, and operational alignment across all UK strategic priorities while navigating Risk, Compliance, and Legal clearance for new commercial structures. Your Profile Qualifications & Experience A background in Investment Banking (especially FIG), M&A Advisory, Corporate Finance, Consulting or Strategic BD experience in financial services/fintech is highly desirable. Highly analytical and proactive mindset, avoiding reactive "firefighting" in favor of methodical, structured, data-backed execution and strategic planning. Essential Skills & Core Competencies Strategic acumen: strong commercial instincts and a thorough appreciation for UK market dynamics. Commercial & Financial Rigour: Strong financial modeling, valuation, contract negotiation, and analytical skills honed in high-pressure environments. Stakeholder Management & Influence: Proven ability to influence, challenge, and align internal Group stakeholders, C-suite executives, and external partners. Versatility: Comfortable pivoting seamlessly between financial modeling, client-facing sales meetings, and internal project coordination. Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills suited for Board level interaction and external partner pitching. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of £1,700 and 4 full training days per year. Always hungry? Breakfast, snacks, daily fresh fruit and drinks are at your disposal around the clock. We are hybrid working, we are in the office twice a week, giving the team the opportunity to collaborate and spend time together. Wednesday is our core day in the office. We offer 28 days + Bank Holidays of holiday a year. One day birthday leave to celebrate your birthday. We offer you a company stakeholder pension with a minimum employer contribution of 5%. The opportunity to experience our annual retreats in exciting European cities and other team building events. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

items.title: Senior Account Executive - Technology
items.location_text: San Francisco, Boston, Seattle, New York
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! SENIOR ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE - TECHNOLOGY Why this role? In this role, you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals with Global 2000, large enterprises within the Technology sector. We're looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with prospects to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere's platform can help them achieve their business goals. You'll lay the foundation for Cohere's growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across customer success, sales development, marketing, and solution architecture. You'll be the voice of the field and help our product and engineering teams prioritize the Cohere roadmap with customer-centric care. It's a highly self-directed role, so you should be someone who thrives in an unstructured and quickly evolving environment. And your opportunity for impact will be astronomical — Cohere has skies-the-limit potential, and you'll help us reach it. As an Account Executive focused on the Technology sector you will: - Focus on net-new logo acquisition via outbound activity and relationship building with key stakeholders while also bringing a strong network of key decision-maker and influencer contacts and relationships in the vertical to accelerate engagements, drive strategic partnerships and win sales opportunities - Work closely with customers and prospects as a consultative, trusted advisor who deeply understands their challenges and goals, their technology ecosystem, and will tailor solutions to drive measurable impact for their businesses - Work in close partnership with channel partners to find opportunities to scale outreach and customer satisfaction in your region - Collaborate with product and engineering teams as well as customer success on strategic motions to deliver solutions to large enterprise customers - Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity - Own the full sales cycle – from initial outreach through proof-of-concept, deal close, and deployment; this is not a transactional sale that you can walk away from after the contract is signed but rather requires ongoing oversight of the project to ensure success You may be a good fit if you have: - 8-12+ years of previous B2B sales experience with Global 2000, large enterprises in the Technology sector, negotiating and closing transformational multi-year (2-5 year) SaaS deals in the 7 figure range, and a track record of high performance and exceeding quota - Previous experience as a technical consultative salesperson, selling complex products, such as developer tools, API products, or AI / NLP solutions, are a plus, with a focus on applications in the Financial Services sector - Previous experience working with customers during the deployment phase of the engagement, aligning on how best to configure and customize the solution that supports success in production and builds trust to set up for expansion and growth - Previous experience working with channel partners such as cloud hyperscalers and system integrators to drive sales cycles and hit shared revenue goals - High tolerance for ambiguity - as an early sales hire, you'll have to be a self-starter, doer and a strategist who is capable of wearing many hats and doing what it takes to figure out a path to success - Curiosity - you want to go deep on NLP and become an expert on our technology while considering how to fit into a large organization's technology landscape with a focus on its applications in the Financial Services sectors - Fantastic communication skills - you are a great listener, have a knack for understanding what matters most to others, build strong relationships, can speak to the c-suite, and feel comfortable speaking to both technical and non-technical audiences in the Financial Services sector Additional Requirements: - Deep understanding of the Technology industry, including key trends, challenges, and opportunities - Ability to articulate the value of AI and NLP solutions in the context of Financial Services operations. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Affiliate Growth Lead, US
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We are looking for an Affiliate Growth Lead, US to build and scale our relationships with finance and investing creators and affiliates across the US market. The role combines business development, creator and affiliate partnerships and performance marketing, with a clear commercial mandate: drive attributable funded accounts and trading volume from active traders and investors, starting with Margin. This is not a crypto-native KOL role. The audience we want to reach already trades and invests, and we reach them through the creators and publishers they trust in traditional finance, trading education and wealth management. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own business development for US finance and investing creators and affiliates, building a high-quality pipeline of trading educators, finance YouTubers and podcasters, newsletter authors, and wealth-management and advisor-creators. - Develop and execute the US creator and affiliate strategy, starting with a focus on driving Margin trading volume and funded accounts, with the scope to expand across Kraken's other trading products. - Own partner acquisition and relationship development, from initial outreach and commercial conversations through activation and ongoing growth. - Structure CPA, revenue-share and hybrid partnerships that tie partner incentives to funded accounts and trading activity. - Set up and manage the tracking, attribution, payout and reporting needed to measure partners through funded and traded accounts. - Work with Legal and Compliance on disclosure, content review and approved messaging, so that promotion of leveraged products is responsible and consistent. - Partner across Growth, Marketing, Product and other relevant teams to turn creator and affiliate opportunities into effective campaigns, and bring partner and audience feedback back into the product. - Coordinate with the NORAM Pro KOL Business Development team so each creator has a single point of contact and relationships are not duplicated. - Track attributable trading volume, funded accounts, active-trader retention and CAC per partner, and use the results to prioritize partners and investment. - Continuously identify emerging creators, communities and affiliate publishers that reach active traders and investors in the US. items.title: Commercial Manager (m/f/x)
items.description: We are Tipico, Germany's leading sports betting provider and one of the most dynamic tech companies in the industry, part of Banijay Gaming - a European champion in sports betting and online gaming. We approach every challenge like a Championship match, with a mission to excite the arena and elevate the betting experience for every customer. Our culture is energetic and ambitious—we play as a team to win high, leave an impact, and commit to excellence. Fueled by our passion for the perfect product, we use the newest tech stack to get better every single day. Your daily pitch Do you enjoy connecting the dots across an organisation and turning ideas into scalable business solutions? Are you someone who looks at opportunities from every angle — commercial, operational, compliance, and customer impact — before making the call? In this role, you’ll be the playmaker of new initiatives, connecting departments and making sure every move counts. Whether it’s a new feature, process, or operational change, you’ll assess the impact across the business, keep everything in line with regulatory rules and commercial interests, and guide stakeholders toward the best play. Reporting to the Head of Business Process Excellence, you’ll make sure every new development is fit for the big league that is scalable, compliant, commercially strong, and fully aligned with our winning strategy. At Tipico, we believe in owning our game. Are you ready to step onto the pitch, bring your best self, and become a champion? Then show us your game face – because we're looking for a Commercial Manager (m/f/x) to join the team! Your playing field Own the governance, performance, and continuous improvement of key business processes to ensure they remain scalable, compliant and aligned with business objectives across multiple regulated markets. Define and monitor process KPIs, identify opportunities to improve performance, and optimise how your processes support overall business objectives. Act as the cross-functional connector between Product, Operations, Compliance, Commercial, and other teams when introducing new initiatives or product features. Evaluate and challenge new proposals from a business perspective, ensuring they are operationally feasible, compliant, and commercially viable. Analyse the impact of new features and changes on business performance, operational processes, and customer experience. Lead cross-functional discussions, and drive stakeholder alignment to ensure successful implementation of initiatives. Assess cost, operational efficiency, and return on investment when reviewing new initiatives. Translate business needs into clear requirements and ensure business, operational, and regulatory impacts are understood before implementation. Which skills should you bring to the pitch Qualification. You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field, or bring equivalent professional experience. Experience. You bring experience in Business Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Development, or Country Management, ideally within fast-paced digital businesses. Experience within the Gaming, Fintech, or Payments industry would be an advantage. Business Mindset. You are comfortable assessing initiatives from multiple perspectives including commercial viability, operational impact, compliance, and customer value. Strategic Thinking. You are able to connect the big picture with operational realities, ensuring new initiatives align with business strategy and deliver tangible value. Analytical skills. You have strong analytical capabilities and enjoy working with data to evaluate performance, identify trends, and support decision-making. Stakeholder management. You are confident working across departments and influencing stakeholders to drive alignment and progress. Ownership. You take full responsibility for initiatives and processes, ensuring they are well-governed and executed effectively. Language Skills. English is the official language at the office, therefore fluency in English is essential. As the #1 sports betting provider in Germany, German would be a plus. Customer-centric mindset. You always consider the customer impact when evaluating changes and improvements. This is how we score with you: Established International Group. We have a solid foundation on which to grow Personal and Professional Growth. We offer you opportunities to develop and grow to unlock your potential. Relocation Support. To make your move to Malta as smooth as possible Competitive Package. We care for our employees, offering an indefinite contract, competitive salary, insurances (private health, dental, private accident, sickness and life) and free parking. On-site childcare. We’ve got a game plan to support you and your 3+ year old kids. Sports Incentive. We want you to remain active and will subsidise a gym membership of your choice. Modern offices. Our very own Tipico tower provides an open plan space with the latest technology. Events. Sponsored Charity and Team gatherings, we like to have fun together as one team and reinforce our connections. Supportive Environment . We believe in collaboration and working together as a team but we also give importance to the uniqueness of each and every one of us. Think a career at Tipico is right for you? Apply now and join our winning team. If you have any questions or comments about this role, our TA team is happy to help you! Feel free to reach out to us on our social media channels We look forward to your application!

items.title: Director of Partnerships, Robinhood Money
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood’s Money team is building the next generation of banking and spending products for all Americans, starting with jaw-dropping Credit Cards. Our team members drive never-before-seen products and features from concept to launch to hyperscale. As Director of Partnerships for our Money team, you will own the end-to-end partnerships strategy for Robinhood’s financial services ecosystem, from originating and closing high-stakes deals to scaling the relationships and teams that power our most critical products. This role is based in our New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Originating, negotiating, and closing high-impact partnerships with leading consumer brands, major retailers, and strategic partners to unlock compelling customer benefits, rewards, and experiences. Lead end-to-end commercial negotiations with key partners, structuring multi-year agreements that cover commercial economics, legal, security, and privacy terms, always putting the user first. Serve as the primary executive-facing relationship owner for Robinhood’s most strategic partners, driving quarterly business reviews, partner health metrics, and long-term roadmap alignment. Partner directly with Product, Engineering, Design, and Research to translate partnership capabilities into product roadmap acceleration and new user-facing features at scale. Build and lead a high-performing partnerships team, setting clear goals, developing talent, scaling the function, and driving operational rigor across partner onboarding, integration, and ongoing management. Identify and lead strategic initiatives with partners that directly move team OKRs, improving economics, accelerating product delivery, and expanding Robinhood’s competitive position in financial services. What you bring Significant experience in partnerships, business development, or strategy within fintech, consumer technology, or financial services with a proven track record of closing and scaling complex, high-value deals from origination through execution. Deep expertise in the financial services ecosystem: payment networks, banking infrastructure, embedded finance, and the business models that drive consumer fintech at scale. Demonstrated ability to lead commercial negotiations end-to-end including revenue-share models, API and data-sharing frameworks, and co-marketing structures with the cross-functional fluency to align Legal, Finance, and Engineering behind each deal. Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build trust with both internal senior leadership and C-suite contacts at partner organizations. An established network within major payment networks (Visa, Mastercard), top-tier banks, or adjacent fintech platforms. Leadership expectations Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them: Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech. Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly. Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $242,000 — $285,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $213,000 — $251,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $189,000 — $222,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? As a Senior Account Executive at Cohere you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals, with Defense, Federal Civilian and Local Government Agencies in Germany. In this role you will be focussed on business development activity across all PUBSEC Government Agencies and Departments in Germany. We’re looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with public sector customers to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere’s platform can help them drive better mission and citizen outcomes. You’ll lay the foundation for Cohere’s growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across Customer Success, Sales Development, Marketing, and Sales Engineering. You’ll be the voice of the field and help our Product and Engineering teams prioritize the Cohere roadmap with customer-centric care. In this highly self-directed role, you will thrive in a quickly evolving environment. As a Senior Account Executive, you will: - Drive net-new customer acquisition through targeted outbound activity, senior leader engagement, and relationship building in Germany. - Develop and execute a sales plan for Germany, prioritizing accounts and opportunities through collaboration with Cohere leadership. - Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to public sector customers and prospects by understanding their goals and shaping AI solutions that deliver measurable value - Work closely with channel and regional partners, as well as major system integrators to scale outreach, accelerate adoption, and maximize customer success - Leverage senior-level relationships with executives and government decision-makers to drive strategic opportunities and long-term partnerships - Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams on strategic efforts to deliver enterprise and public-sector solutions - Partner with SDRs and Marketing to drive top-of-funnel activity and overall territory growth - Own the full sales cycle; including discovery, technical and business validation, proof-of-concept, procurement, and deal close within a team-selling environment You may be a good fit if you have: - 10+ years of direct public sector sales experience in Germany, with a proven track record of closing $3M+ annual quotas. - Deep knowledge of PUBSEC procurement and budget cycles, decision-making processes, and how to work with regional partners and resellers. - Established network in Germany, including federal agencies, prime contractors, and industry associations. - Experience selling SaaS, AI/ML, or enterprise software solutions to government clients. - High tolerance for ambiguity, you are both a strategist and a hands-on operator capable of building a market from the ground up - Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple internal and external stakeholders across fast-moving deals - Creativity and strong technical acumen to structure unique, mutually beneficial partnerships - Excellent communication skills, you listen deeply, understand what matters to senior decision-makers, and confidently present to both technical and non-technical audiences. - English and German language proficiency essential. - Must be based in Germany with willingness to travel (25-35%). FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Senior Partnerships Manager (UK)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Join our team of Relationship Managers and become part of an impactful and dynamic environment. Our team plays a central role at Raisin, responsible for fostering partnerships with our platforms’ partner banks. As a Partnership Manager, you'll play a crucial role in driving Raisin's growth across Europe and the UK. Your primary mission is to cultivate and oversee daily interactions with Raisin's partner banks, and to lead or support managing key accounts. Beyond that, you'll spearhead the launch of new products, integration of new banks into Raisin's and our B2B partners' marketplaces, and improving their technical integration with us to ensure scalability and the growth of the banks’ assets under management and ultimately the Raisin platform. With our far-reaching impact and diverse stakeholders, we have a comprehensive view of platform-wide evolutions, and others depend on your ability to communicate these changes and their broader implications. We are ultimately accountable for owning and managing our partner banks, taking direct responsibility for the performance and reporting of those partners and bringing new savings products to the consumer market. To excel in this role, you should be adept at managing senior stakeholders, both internally and externally. We’re a high growth fintech business, so the ability to work on multiple relationships and ad-hoc projects concurrently is key. Your Responsibilities As a Senior Partnership Manager , you will serve as a commercial lead and strategic advisor for our portfolio of partner banks in the UK and Europe. Moving beyond traditional relationship management, this role requires a consultative, balance-sheet-first mindse t to help executive banking leadership solve liquidity, capital, and deposit-funding challenges using Raisin's platform technology. C-Suite Advisory & Partner Ownership: Act as the primary strategic contact for Treasury Heads, Chief Financial Officers, and C-suite banking executives, aligning Raisin's platform capabilities with their balance sheet, liquidity, and cost-of-funding objectives. Commercial Strategy & Portfolio Expansion: Proactively structure, negotiate, and execute commercial growth strategies to scale partner Assets Under Management (AUM) and launch new deposit product lines. Structured Problem-Solving & Execution: Lead complex, multi-stakeholder workstreams across internal cross-functional teams (Solutions Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations) to ensure seamless bank onboarding and technical integrations. Strategic Market Expansion: Drive priority commercial initiatives across the UK and EEA markets, identifying opportunities to launch adjacent financial products and expand strategic partner coverage. What Success Looks Like: Executive Positioning: Establish yourself as a trusted commercial advisor to executive leadership across your assigned bank portfolio. AUM & Portfolio Growth: Deliver measurable deposit growth by optimizing bank partner pricing, funding targets, and market positioning. Flawless Program Execution: Successfully lead complex bank integration and product launch milestones on schedule. Your Profile Education: Top-tier Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related quantitative discipline. Professional Background: 3–6+ years of experience in Management Consulting or Investment Banking (FIG background) or Strategic Partnerships within a B2B Fintech/BaaS scale-up. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Strong command of bank balance sheets, deposit mechanics, regulatory frameworks, and commercial deal structuring. Structured Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional capability to translate complex financial and technical concepts into structured executive presentations for bank leaders. Project & Stakeholder Ownership: Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-variable projects autonomously in fast-paced environments. Nice-to-Haves Direct experience with UK/EEA banking regulations (FCA, BaFin), liquidity coverage ratios (LCR), or BaaS/Open Banking infrastructure. Transaction, M&A, treasury, or advisory experience working directly with UK and European retail or commercial banks. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of £1,700 and 4 full training days per year. Always hungry? Breakfast, snacks, daily fresh fruit and drinks are at your disposal around the clock. We are hybrid working, we are in the office twice a week, giving the team the opportunity to collaborate and spend time together. Wednesday is our core day in the office. We offer 28 days + Bank Holidays of holiday a year. One day birthday leave to celebrate your birthday. We offer you a company stakeholder pension with a minimum employer contribution of 5%. The opportunity to experience our annual retreats in exciting European cities and other team building events. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

This is a highly autonomous role demanding ownership of multi-million-dollar territories. items.title: Director, Experiential Partnerships - Fanatics Events
items.description: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. About Fanatics Events Fanatics Events creates large-scale consumer festivals and live experiences that bring fans, athletes, brands and partners together. Our flagship productions include Fanatics Fest, a multi-day fan festival combining sports, collectibles, athlete appearances, content, and immersive brand experiences; and WWE World, a multi-day consumer event produced in partnership with WWE. As we continue to scale our live events business, we are seeking an Experiential Partnerships Director to lead the development and execution of complex brand partnership programs across Fanatics Events. The Role The Director of Experiential Partnerships is a senior individual contributor responsible for turning ambitious brand partnership ideas into exceptional, executable fan experiences. The role owns major partner programs from early-stage concept development through onsite execution, working across partnerships, creative and operational teams to shape solutions, support new business development, pressure-test feasibility and lead delivery once sold. The ideal candidate has personally led complex experiential programs for brands at major tentpole events and combines strategic thinking with the operator judgment to anticipate challenges, mobilize teams and move programs from idea to execution. What You'll Do Shape & Sell the Solution Support the development of pitch materials and partnership proposals, helping translate experiential concepts into clear, compelling client-facing recommendations. Lead and support partner pitches, bringing an experiential and operational point of view to new business conversations. Pressure-test concepts for feasibility, cost, timing, dependencies, and execution risk before commitments are made. Support management of the pipeline, including opportunity tracking, revenue forecasting, budgets, and financial projections. Engage the appropriate internal teams early to ensure partnership solutions are both ambitious and executable. Own the Program Own assigned partnerships from kickoff through onsite execution and post-event wrap. Translate commercial commitments and creative concepts into clear work-streams, timelines, budgets, and decision points. Drive execution across Creative, Operations, Production, Talent, Marketing, Media, Legal, Finance, agencies, and vendors. Maintain command of the overall program while holding functional experts accountable for their respective workstreams. Oversee Delivery Anticipate operational challenges and dependencies before they become critical issues. Bring clear recommendations and solutions when navigating ambiguity or changing circumstances. Maintain financial discipline across assigned programs, identifying potential scope or budget exposure early. In collaboration with Operations, manage assigned partner programs onsite, making timely decisions and resolving issues in a fast-moving live environment. Lead the Partner & Operation Serve as the primary day-to-day lead for assigned brand partners and their agencies. Set clear expectations around scope, timelines, responsibilities, and decision-making. Navigate evolving partner requests while protecting program feasibility, economics, and the overall fan experience. Build trusted relationships across partner organizations and effectively engage senior Fanatics leadership when appropriate. What We're Looking For 8–12 years of experience in experiential marketing, integrated brand experiences, live events, sponsorship activation, or related disciplines. Demonstrated experience personally leading complex experiential programs from concept development through onsite execution. Experience delivering major tentpole events and programs for blue-chip brands. Experiential agency experience strongly preferred and will be prioritized . Strong event production fluency and an understanding of how creative concepts translate into operational and financial requirements. Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous or incomplete information and turn it into a clear recommendation and actionable plan. Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional teams, agencies, and vendors without direct reporting authority. Strong client-facing communication skills, financial discipline and comfort operating independently in fast-moving environments. Willingness to travel and work onsite during major event weeks, including weekends as needed. What Success Looks Like Partnership concepts add value to the fan experience, are operationally feasible, and appropriately scoped before going to market. Partner programs move from concept through execution with clear ownership, strong financial discipline, and minimal late-stage surprises. Programs are delivered on time, on budget and at the quality expected by Fanatics and its partners. Partners and internal teams view you as a trusted leader who can turn ambitious ideas into exceptional live experiences. The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here .

items.location_text: United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Ireland, Sweden, Romania, Cyprus, Switzerland, Portugal, Lithuania, Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, Bulgaria
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Payward Services (PWS) is the Infrastructure arm of Payward, the parent company of Kraken, whose businesses span trading, payments, custody, banking, asset management, and services. PWS gives regulated businesses direct API access to the infrastructure that has powered Kraken for 15+ years. Payward holds 100+ regulatory licences, operates in 190+ jurisdictions, and processes $2T+ in annual volume. Payward has also applied for a national trust company charter to offer custody and trust services to institutional and high-net-worth clients across the U.S. The company is backed by strategic investors including Citadel Securities, Jane Street, Deutsche Börse, and Nasdaq. Operated through Paywards’s regulated entities, custody combines segregated client accounts, institutional-grade key management and cold storage, independent audit and control reporting, and direct connectivity into Kraken's exchange, staking, and financing rails. Clients get the security posture of a dedicated custodian alongside the liquidity and product depth of one of the longest-running exchanges in crypto. THE OPPORTUNITY As Senior Sales Lead, Custody & Wealth Management, you will lead the go-to-market efforts for Payward custody offering, including qualified custody, across two motions: Institutional custody sales: Sell to banks, neobanks, fintechs, payment companies, brokerages, exchanges, asset managers, and any business that needs regulated digital asset custody, globally. B2B2C wealth solutions: Work with Product to design and launch embedded custody and digital asset solutions. Private banks, wealth managers, family offices, and platforms serving high-net-worth clients can offer these to their own clients under their own brand, alongside PWS staking, trading, payments, and tokenized assets. You will report to the Global Head of Sales, Payward Services, as a senior individual contributor. You will work closely with Solution Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and Onboarding, and act as the voice of the custody and wealth market in roadmap discussions. Lead and help define the global GTM strategy for Custody across institutional segments, asset managers, ETF and fund issuers, hedge funds, market makers and prop firms, banks and wealth platforms, corporates and treasuries, family offices, token issuers and foundations, and exchanges requiring third-party custody. This role will be expected to: - Grow assets under custody and custody revenue as the primary outcomes, with clear ownership of targets, forecasting, and pipeline discipline - Develop commercial frameworks across custody, trading, and yield products including vaults and staking. - Lead revenue across a range of relationships from long cycle RFP driven enterprise mandates to mid-market motion for funds, corporates, and crypto-native clients who need to onboard fast. - Own the full client lifecycle from qualification and diligence through agreement negotiation, onboarding, and expansion into staking, trading, collateral, and settlement. - Build and scale a revenue growth in the custody and wealth management vertical across a global Sales and BD organization, with an AI-first approach to tooling, pipeline management, and operational efficiency. - Establish Payward as the default custodian across the institutional ecosystem, fund administrators, wealth managers, family offices, consultants, prime brokers, OTC desks, and the service providers who shape custodian space. - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Finance to align commercial strategy with platform capability and the regulatory perimeter of each entity - Expand Payward’'s custody footprint across the UK, Europe, US and APAC and other priority markets, with a clear view on licensing constraints and how to sequence market entry - Feed the product roadmap with structured client demand: asset and chain coverage, staking, reporting and integrations, collateral mobility, and off-exchange settlement WHAT YOU BRING - 7+ years of experience building and scaling B2B or B2B2C revenue organizations within digital asset custody, Wealth management, traditional custody and asset servicing, or regulated financial infrastructure - Proven track record closing and expanding complex, long-cycle mandates with institutional clients where security, regulatory, and operational diligence sit at the center of the buying decision - Deep understanding of the wealth management space, how institutions actually select a custodian, risk and investment committees, operational due diligence, asset segregation and bankruptcy remoteness, insurance, audit and control reporting, and multi-custodian mandates - Deep experience structuring custody economics: AUC-based pricing, minimums, revenue-share models, and multi-product commercial agreements - Strong commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and executive presence at the C-suite and board level - Experience building and leading high-performing global Sales and BD teams - Demonstrated ability to implement AI-first sales tooling, CRM discipline, and scalable go-to-market systems - International experience strongly preferred; US and European market knowledge - Genuine conviction in crypto and the future of financial market infrastructure or deep, transferable expertise from traditional custody, fund services, or prime brokerage with a clear path to crypto fluency NICE TO HAVES - Direct experience selling qualified custody, staking, or prime brokerage services to institutional clients - Relationships across the institutional service provider ecosystem: fund administrators, auditors, consultants, transfer agents, and ETF issuers - Working knowledge of institutional key management (MPC, HSM, multi-sig), cold storage architecture, off-exchange settlement, and collateral mobility - Familiarity with KYC/AML frameworks and digital asset licensing regimes across multiple jurisdictions - Experience scaling a B2B sales motion from founder-led or relationship-led origination to a structured, team-driven engine - Experience selling into token issuers, foundations, and protocol treasuries alongside traditional financial institutions - Exposure to staking economics, validator operations, and the reporting institutions expect around both Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.
