items.title: Senior Account Executive, Audience & Curation
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com THE ROLE: The Brands & Agencies organization is run as five pods, one per buyer group. Your pod, WPP , Publicis, or Omnicom is led by a VP and staffed with account executives who own the client and planning relationships. You're the technical specialist in that pod: you own the two layers the rest of the team supports but doesn't run, your H oldco's data organization and its trading desk. This is a specialist individual-contributor role, not a junior one. You’ll carry your own curation and audience revenue number, and you will be the most technical person in the room on most calls, including calls where your VP is the senior relationship owner and you are there because the questions have gotten specific. This is a heavy, hands-on sales role. You will live inside your assigned Holdco's trading desk and data organization. Working directly with trading and buying teams, and building relationships across investment, curation, and programmatic teams, to personally lead deals end-to-end. You'll work side-by-side with Ad Operations, Product, and our Insights team to translate our audience products into the solutions those buying teams need. What You'll Do Carry the curation and audience number Own and exceed an individual quota for curated-deal and audience revenue within your assigned holdco. Source, lead, and close curated deal and segment agreements with your Holdco's trading, curation, and data teams, from first conversation through commercial terms, taxonomy sign-off, and activation. Keep pipeline and forecast accurate in CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce), and know the difference between a deal that is signed and a deal that is actually spending. Report on what is live and what is stuck: deals activated, segments distributed, spend flowing through curated packages, and the specific blocker on anything that has stalled. Own the trading desk relationship Get Genius curated deal IDs and PMPs into the packages your holdco's central trading and curation unit buys from, and into the agency-level programmatic teams that draw on them. Work fluently in the platforms these teams live in: The Trade Desk, DV360, Amazon DSP, Yahoo DSP, and the major SSP and curation platforms, plus your Holdco's own proprietary planning and activation stack. Negotiate deal structure the way trading teams think about it; floor pricing, fees and take rates, scale and match-rate guarantees, tiering, and reporting SLAs and know when a curated deal is the right vehicle versus a segment license. Solve the unglamorous problems that decide whether a deal scales: deal-ID hygiene, throughput and win rates, discrepancy resolution, and the reasons a curated package underdelivers. This is a large part of the job and the part that most often decides whether a test renews. Own the data and audience relationship Get Genius segments distributed, priced, and discoverable everywhere your holdco's data teams shop: DSP data marketplaces, LiveRamp, Snowflake and other data-collaboration environments, and identity frameworks including UID2 and RampID. Map Genius audiences into your holdco's proprietary taxonomy and audience framework so a planner finds them where they already look, under names they already use. Partner with your holdco's analytics and data-science teams on clean-room work, modeling, incrementality design, and the measurement standards they use to grade audience performance. Own the answers to the five questions every data buyer asks: scale, match rate, freshness, how the audience was constructed, and proof it drove something. Make the rest of the pod dangerous Be the technical escalation for your VP and account executives. The person they pull into a call when the questions get specific, and who they can send in alone when they cannot make it. Turn what you learn at the desk and the data team into enablement the pod can use: how our audiences are built, what they cost, what they beat, and which objections have already been answered. Feed deal-level friction back to Product and Data Engineering; new audiences, refresh cadence, scale and match rates, and the gaps that keep costing deals at your holdco. Work with Ad Ops, Insights, and Marketing on case studies, benchmark reporting, and the post-campaign proof that turns a test into a renewed commitment. Share pricing precedent, objection patterns, and winning structures with the Curation & Audience Leads in the other Holdco pods, what one of you proves should shorten the path for the others. WHAT YOU’LL BRING: 4-6 years in programmatic, curation, audience data, or agency trading on the sell side, at an agency desk, or at a platform, with at least some time spent responsible for revenue rather than only for execution. Hands-on fluency in the audience supply chain: deal IDs and curation, DSP and SSP mechanics, data marketplaces and onboarding, identity and match rates, clean rooms, and CPM-versus-data-fee economics. You should be able to diagnose why a deal is not spending without asking anyone. Direct experience working with or inside a major HoldCo (WPP, Publicis, or Omnicom) you know its stack, its taxonomy, and roughly how a new data partner gets approved. Working relationships at a major holdco's trading, curation, or data teams, or a demonstrable ability to build them quickly at that layer. Ability to sell a data product on its merits to buyers who will pressure-test every claim, and to hold your own in a technical conversation with an analytics lead. Comfort making complex things simple: you can explain moment-based audience construction to a trading lead who has 11 other meetings that day, without either oversimplifying or losing them. Operating discipline: accurate forecasting, clean CRM hygiene (HubSpot or Salesforce), and reliable follow-through on the operational detail that makes deals actually spend. IT WILL BE A BONUS IF YOU: Spent time at an agency trading desk, curation platform, SSP, DSP, data provider, or identity company. Background in sports media, sports data, or fan-engagement products. Familiarity with clean-room and data-collaboration environments (Snowflake, LiveRamp, InfoSum, Amazon Marketing Cloud) and with attention or outcomes-based measurement. Experience as the technical specialist inside a pod or account team, supporting sellers who own the senior relationships. Ad ops or campaign management experience, the instinct for why a campaign underdelivers is hard to teach and valuable here. This role offers an annualized salary of $130,000 - $150,000, plus variable compensation, and includes eligibility for Genius Sports Group’s benefits plan. We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

You’ll be the voice of the field and help our product and engineering teams prioritize the Cohere roadmap with customer-centric care. items.title: Integrity Sales & Partnerships Lead
items.description: We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. Integrity Sales & Partnerships Lead reports to the VP, Integrity Services and serves as a member of the Integrity Services global Sales & Partnerships team. The role combines business development, strategic account management, commercial planning, and regional sales operations responsibilities to drive sustainable revenue growth across the Integrity Services portfolio. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying and converting new business opportunities, expanding strategic client relationships, and supporting the execution of the global product-led commercial strategy. Working closely with product owners, operational teams, and other Sportradar business units, the individual will act as a trusted advisor to sporting organisations while contributing directly to regional and global revenue objectives. This position requires a commercially minded and results-oriented professional with strong business acumen, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to balance independent ownership of opportunities with collaborative execution across a global team. THE CHALLENGE Act as a member of the global commercial team, driving new business acquisition, account expansion, and cross-sell opportunities across the full Integrity Services portfolio, including Anti-Match-Fixing, Integrity Education, Due Diligence, Athlete Protection, Anti-Doping, and other Integrity Services solutions. Identify, evaluate, and advance commercial opportunities across sporting entities, including international federations, national federations, leagues, clubs, event organisers, regulators, and other key stakeholders. Own individual revenue, pipeline, and business development targets, contributing directly to regional and global Integrity Services growth objectives. Develop and execute strategic account plans for priority clients, identifying opportunities for contract renewals, service expansion, and long-term partnership growth. Provide exceptional account management and customer care, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers across the sports ecosystem. Collaborate closely with global product owners and commercial colleagues to identify, develop, and progress opportunities across the Integrity Services portfolio. Actively contribute market intelligence, client feedback, and competitive insights to support product development, commercial strategy, and go-to-market planning. Represent Sportradar Integrity Services at industry conferences, forums, workshops, and stakeholder events. Work closely with other Sportradar business units to identify joint opportunities, support strategic pursuits, and maximise the value of existing client relationships. Maintain accurate pipeline, opportunity, contract, and forecasting data within Salesforce, ensuring transparency and consistency across the sales cycle. Support commercial planning and regional forecasting through the preparation of revenue reports, pipeline analysis, business reviews, and market assessments. Contribute to the development of regional market intelligence, identifying emerging trends, governance developments, regulatory changes, competitive dynamics, and growth opportunities. Develop and maintain expert knowledge of the Integrity Services portfolio, products, and market positioning, acting as a trusted internal and external subject matter expert. Drive operational excellence and regional efficiency through disciplined Salesforce utilisation, commercial reporting, pricing consistency, and contract management processes. ABOUT YOU Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Sports Management, International Relations, Law, Finance, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in sports business, sports technology, integrity, governance, betting, consulting, or a related commercial environment. Demonstrated success in business development, account management, partnership management, and revenue generation. Strong understanding of the sports ecosystem, including sporting federations, leagues, clubs, governing bodies, regulators, and commercial stakeholders. Proven ability to develop senior stakeholder relationships and navigate complex sales environments. Experience working in an international business environment, collaborating effectively across functions, regions, and product teams. Strong commercial acumen with experience managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and commercial reporting. Advanced experience using Salesforce and other CRM platforms to manage opportunities, forecasting, account planning, and sales performance. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable operating independently while contributing to a collaborative global team environment. Passionate about sport, integrity, governance, and the role technology can play in protecting and enhancing sport. Willingness to travel regularly throughout the region and internationally when required. OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Two Hiring Team Interviews : Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Onsite Interview (If not organized on prior interview stages): Meet with the local team and take a tour of our office for a final meet-and-greet. Final Steps : Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! items.title: Head of Business Development – Sportsbook, LATAM
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com The Role - Head of Business Development Manager – Sportsbook, LATAM We’re seeking an exceptional Head of Business Development to drive new commercial opportunities across the sportsbook and betting sectors in Latin America. This is a high-impact revenue-driving role for someone who thrives on closing deals, hitting ambitious targets, and building solution-oriented partnerships. You’ll be responsible for identifying new prospects, understanding their business challenges, and matching Genius Sports’ products and services to deliver value. While he/she will be an individual contributor in the near term, the ideal candidate will be expected to manage and lead a team of business development professionals over the long term. The ideal candidate is experienced, strategic and adept at dealmaking. This is someone who has a robust existing network, can open new doors, and close six and seven-figure deals. You’ll be comfortable working independently, while also collaborating closely with internal teams to deliver winning solutions for our betting partners. While you don’t need a technical background, you must have a strong understanding of the betting ecosystem, be able to quickly understand our products, and communicate their value confidently to senior decision-makers in the Latin American betting market. This role requires you to immerse yourself in the betting industry, stay on top of market developments, and represent Genius Sports with energy and credibility at conferences, meetings, and industry events across Latin America. If you’re passionate about being a commercial leader, love sports, and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, this role is for you. What You’ll Bring Proven success in B2B consultative sales, with a strong track record of consistently hitting or exceeding challenging revenue targets Existing experience within the Betting industry or selling to Betting clients in LATAM Fluency in both Spanish & English languages; Portuguese fluency is a bonus Experience closing six-figure (or higher) deals on a consistent basis A results-oriented mindset with high-energy and positive attitude A competitive spirit, resilience and a deep motivation to win Strong commercial creativity and deal-making skills, with the ability to structure and close complex partnerships Excellent communication and presentation skills, including confidence engaging with and presenting to C-suite executives Solid numerical, analytical, and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail A collaborative team player who enjoys working with like-minded, sports-obsessed colleagues A genuine interest in sports and a desire to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven company Willingness and ability to travel within Latin America, attend conferences and events, and meet customers face-to-face to close deals We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. Occasional travel may be required. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports. Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? In this role, you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals with Global 2000 across Sweden, Denmark and Norway in telecommunications, financial services, industrial manufacturing, energy and utilities, and healthcare and life sciences. Sovereignty and control over where data and models reside are growing priorities across these sectors, and Cohere is well positioned to meet that need with private, on-premise and in-country deployment built for enterprise scale. We’re looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with prospects to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere’s platform can help them achieve their business goals. You’ll lay the foundation for Cohere’s growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across customer success, sales development, marketing, and solution architecture. As a Senior Account Executive, you will: - Drive net-new customer acquisition across Sweden, Denmark and Norway via targeted outbound activity, executive introductions, and relationship building with key stakeholders - Own the full sales cycle – from initial outreach, technical and business validation, through deal close - Support coverage of adjacent Nordic accounts as territory priorities require - Generate and own your own pipeline through disciplined outbound, research and executive prospecting - Be a trusted advisor to customer prospects, deeply understand their challenges & goals, and tailor solutions to drive impact for their businesses - Leverage senior-level relationships with executives to drive strategic partnerships and sales opportunities - Align closely with our partners and systems integrators to drive shared revenue and extend reach into target accounts - Work cross-functionally across the business, drawing in the right technical and specialist colleagues as each engagement requires - Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives and Marketing to supplement your own top of funnel activity You may be a good fit if you have: - Fluent in at least one Nordic language – Swedish, Norwegian or Danish – in addition to English; additional Nordic languages are a strong advantage - 10+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience with Global 2000 and large enterprise customers along with experience negotiating & closing transformational 7-figure deals - Depth in at least two of our priority sectors: financial services, telecommunications, energy and utilities, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences - A hunter mentality - you take pride in generating your own pipeline and are at your best when building a territory rather than managing an inherited one - A proven track record of high performance and exceeding quotas - Experience building and maintaining senior-level relationships with executives - Experience working alongside channel partners and systems integrators to drive sales cycles and hit shared revenue goals - Excellent communication skills - you are a great listener, have a knack for understanding what matters most to others & building strong relationships, experienced presenting to a C-suite audience, and feel comfortable speaking to both technical and non-technical customer prospects Additional Requirements: - Experience selling complex enterprise level solutions, technical products, and private or on-premise deployments (AI/NLP solutions preferred) - Familiarity with European data residency, sovereignty and regulatory requirements as live buying criteria - This foundational role combines strategic thinking, analytical rigor and hands-on execution to develop differentiated customer propositions, validate product opportunities and launch new go-to-market programs. Working across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Data Science, this person will lead initiatives from opportunity assessment through customer discovery, commercial pilots and transition to scale. The remit includes industry-specific opportunities, differentiated customer engagement models and innovative approaches across self-serve, sales-assisted and partner-led channels. The lead will also partner with SMB leadership and the Strategy & Operations team to inform the overall SMB strategy, contributing customer segmentation, commercial insights and evidence from incubation programs to broader planning and investment decisions. Build business cases and launch pilots to validate customer demand and commercial potential. - Design new acquisition, activation, and expansion programs, including industry-specific and assisted-growth approaches. Tailor acquisition, onboarding, service, and expansion across customer channels. - Own pilot delivery and measurement across incremental revenue, conversion, customer outcomes, and cost to serve. items.title: Senior Affiliate Manager
items.description: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. We are looking for a dedicated Senior Affiliate Manager to join our team in Armenia! About the role: The Senior Affiliate Manager (Tier 1) is a high-ownership role within the PartnerMatrix Managed Services (AMS) team. This person takes full responsibility for a portfolio of iGaming operator clients in established, high-competition markets — managing their affiliate programs end-to-end, growing affiliate traffic, and delivering measurable NGR impact across Tier 1 GEOs including the UK, Germany, Sweden, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, etc. The role requires deep industry expertise, strong affiliate relationships, and the ability to operate independently in regulated environments. What you'll get to do: Client Affiliate Program Management • Own and manage affiliate programs for several assigned iGaming operator clients from day one. • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned operators, regular calls, strategy alignment, performance reviews. • Define and execute affiliate program strategy: GEO targets, payout models (CPA / RevShare / Hybrid), traffic mix goals. • Set up, configure, and maintain affiliate programs within the PartnerMatrix (PMA) platform. • Proactively identify and action program improvements; escalate blockers to the Head of Managed Services and Marketing with proposed solutions. Affiliate Recruitment & Relationship Management • Identify, outreach and onboard high-quality affiliates matching each operator's target GEO and vertical. • Build and maintain strong working relationships with affiliates — be the trusted partner they call first. • Negotiate CPA rates, RevShare deals, and hybrid structures on behalf of operators within approved guidelines. • Run regular check-ins with top-performing affiliates; identify upsell and cross-program opportunities. • Maintain an updated affiliate pipeline per client, track deal status and conversion from outreach to activation. Operational Excellence & Compliance • Ensure all managed affiliates have completed KYC/AML onboarding before activation without exceptions. • Monitor affiliate traffic quality daily, flag fraud signals, bonus abuse patterns, unusual conversion spikes. • Coordinate payment data reconciliation with Finance; review payout files before submission. • Manage affiliate communications via PMA ticketing system; maintain sub-24h response SLA. • Maintain accurate documentation of affiliate deals, contracts and status in the CRM. Reporting & Performance Analysis • Deliver weekly performance reports to each assigned operator (traffic, FTDs, conversions, NGR impact). • Conduct monthly strategy review calls with operators; present data-driven recommendations. • Track KPIs: active affiliate count, payout-to-NGR ratio, new FTDs/month, affiliate retention rate. • Feed insights back to Head of MS for cross-client benchmarking and program strategy refinement. • Contribute to quarterly competitive landscape reviews, flag shifts in affiliate market, rates or GEO trends. Team Contribution • Mentor and support Middle Affiliate Managers — share playbooks, deal structures, GEO learnings. • Document processes and best practices for team knowledge base. • Participate in team calls, contribute to pricing decisions and product feedback for PMA development. What we're looking for: • 3+ years in affiliate management in iGaming • Proven track record of building and growing affiliate programs, not just maintaining them • Hands-on experience with at least one iGaming affiliate platform • Strong existing network of iGaming affiliates across Tier 1 markets (UK, DACH, Nordics, Canada, ANZ) • Understanding of CPA, RevShare and Hybrid commission models, can structure and negotiate deals independently • Fluent in English; German, Swedish, Dutch or French is a significant advantage • Comfortable with data — able to read affiliate reports, spot anomalies, and draw actionable conclusions • Familiarity with regulated market compliance requirements (UKGC, MGA, Spelinspektionen) Nice-to-Have • Experience managing multi-brand or multi-GEO affiliate programs simultaneously • Familiarity with AML/KYC requirements for payment flows in iGaming • Knowledge of Tier 2 or emerging market affiliate ecosystems (CIS, LatAm, MENA) Here's what we offer: · Start with 24 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 34 days by your fifth year with us. · Hybrid work schedule is available after the first three months of employment, with up to 50 days of work from home per year. · Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. · Access online learning platform like Udemy for Business and a budget for external training. · Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. · Private Medical Subscription. · Gym allowance. · Team-building activities in various locations. At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

items.title: Partnerships Operations Lead, OAI for Government
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. OpenAI for Government helps public-sector institutions use advanced AI responsibly to improve services and advance critical missions. The Partnerships team builds the external ecosystem and internal operating mechanisms required to deliver that work at scale. Role Summary We are seeking a Partnerships Operations Lead to build and run the operating foundation for OpenAI for Government’s Partnerships team. This person will serve as the operational connective tissue across the partner team, working closely with Account Directors, Solutions Architects, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, and other cross-functional stakeholders to move opportunities from initial engagement through agreement and execution. They will help ensure a smooth handoff to Technical Success across accounts by establishing clear readiness criteria, capturing the right commercial and customer context, and aligning teams on partner roles, commitments, dependencies, and success outcomes. The ideal candidate is a true utility player who combines the relationship instincts of a growth oriented builder with the rigor of an exceptional business operator. They thrive in ambiguity, create processes that do not yet exist, and move fluidly between deal execution, workflow design, analysis, and cross-functional coordination. Key Responsibilities - Own the end-to-end operating cadence for partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities, from intake and qualification through approvals, contracting, launch, and expansion. - Build and continuously improve operating processes, standard procedures, stage gates, decision rights, and service expectations that make partner execution faster and more predictable. - Operationalize new and existing government partner motions—including cloud providers, resellers, and sell-through models—by translating requirements that differ from standard commercial motions into clear workflows, enablement, decision rights, and cross-functional handoffs. - Coordinate deal execution across Account Directors, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, Security and Compliance, Product, Technical Success, and partner teams, ensuring every action has a clear owner and timeline. - Establish a consistent handoff from commercial teams to Technical Success by standardizing readiness criteria, account context, use cases, partner responsibilities, commitments, dependencies, and success plans. - Unblock complex deals by surfacing issues early, driving approvals and escalations, managing exceptions, and closing gaps between functions. - Maintain the operational source of truth for contract milestones, partner launches, handoff readiness, dependencies, and risks, with a high bar for process and data quality; coordinate with Revenue Operations to ensure partner context is reflected in pipeline and CRM data. - Own the government-partner operating cadences for deal execution, launch tracking, and business reviews; coordinate with Revenue Operations on pipeline and forecasting inputs and turn the resulting data into concise insights and actions. - Identify and implement workflow, tooling, and automation improvements that reduce cycle time, eliminate recurring friction, and enable the partner team to scale. Qualifications - 7+ years of experience in operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, go-to-market business operations, or complex program management. - A track record of building operating processes and cross-functional workflows from the ground up in a fast-moving organization. - Experience supporting the end-to-end deal lifecycle in enterprise technology, public sector, or another complex and regulated environment. - Exceptional program-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple high-priority workstreams, stakeholders, decisions, and deadlines. - Strong systems and data orientation, including experience with CRM, reporting, workflow, and collaboration tools. - Ability to move between detailed execution and systems-level problem solving without losing speed, accuracy, or accountability. - Excellent written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams without relying on formal authority. NICE TO HAVE - Experience operating partner, alliance, channel, or co-sell programs in enterprise technology, cloud, or AI. - Familiarity with public-sector procurement, government contracting, and customer implementation or Technical Success handoffs. You might thrive in this role if you: - Are a true utility player. You are comfortable moving between process design, deal problem-solving, analysis, documentation, and hands-on coordination. - Are a builder. You see ambiguity as an invitation to create clear, durable systems that help teams operate better. - Are deal-oriented. You understand what makes complex opportunities move, anticipate bottlenecks, and bring urgency to the critical path. - Are a cross-functional connector. You translate clearly among commercial, operational, legal, financial, and technical stakeholders and keep teams aligned. - Are a systems thinker. You look for root causes, remove recurring friction, and use data and automation to improve how work gets done. - Take ownership with low ego. You are calm under pressure, highly reliable, and willing to do whatever is needed to help the team and its customers succeed. The role holder will be a subject matter expert in the Spanish Gaming landscape, customer behaviours, market trends and competitor propositions, ensuring our product and commercial strategy remains competitive, innovative and customer-centric. A key aspect of the role will involve aligning promotional and customer engagement strategies around key commercial moments, seasonal campaigns and player behaviours, while also supporting initiatives that maximise customer value and improve retention. Partner closely with BI and Analytics teams to analyse customer behaviour, identify opportunities and translate insights into actionable commercial initiatives. Work alongside CRM, Site and Product teams to optimise customer journeys, engagement and long-term player value. Coordinate with CRM and Customer Engagement teams to align promotional strategies with KPIs performance, personalised offers and Gaming campaigns. Collaborate with Compliance and Legal teams to ensure Gaming propositions remain fully compliant with Spanish regulations while maintaining a strong customer experience. Weekly meetings with VIP teams to review high-value customer segment performance and key customer actions. Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets and convert insights into actionable recommendations. Strong understanding of the Spanish Gaming and entertainment landscape. Ability to translate customer needs into business requirements and commercial action plans. Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Strong communication and influencing capabilities. Proactive, solution-oriented and agile mindset. Native-level Spanish and fluent English (written and spoken). Preferred Experience within regulated Gaming or iGaming environments. Knowledge of Casino, Live Casino and Slots products. Experience working with Gaming suppliers and third-party providers. You will also have access to gym discounts; Healthcare: We prioritize your health and well-being, offering comprehensive healthcare benefits; ...and more. More about evoke We’re a business that embraces change and progress. The power behind big name brands William Hill, 888, and Mr Green, evoke is the new name for 888 Holdings. Marking a new sense of purpose, direction, and ambition for the business, there couldn’t be a more exciting time to join us as we accelerate our journey to bring even greater delight to our customers with world-class betting and gaming experiences. That’s the future. That’s evoke . At evoke, you’ll benefit from flexibility and a culture built on trust. We’ll give you the space to be yourself and the tools you need to protect our customers while they play. We’ll invest in your future to help you develop your unique strengths and build a career that’s right for you. Apply At evoke, we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion for the benefit of our company, employees, and communities. We foster a welcoming and safe workplace that values all forms of diversity and provides opportunities for growth. Sound good? Then you belong at our place! items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com. THE ROLE: The Media Buying Cluster Lead is essential for the design, configuration, and optimization of all media buying campaigns. This role involves collaboration with Business Development and Account Management teams to define campaign objectives, and subsequently own trading strategies to support a range of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). The Lead will be responsible for implementing the campaign setup, continuously monitoring performance, and making necessary adjustments to achieve optimal results. A core function is also to produce detailed, insightful reports for clients detailing campaign performance. Whilst also managing a cluster of media buyers responsible for a book of clients predominantly in real-money gaming, sports betting and performance-led brands. You will be accountable for the KPI outcomes on those accounts as well as your teams’ executional consistency. You will report to the VP of Programmatic Trading and work alongside cluster leads in London, Tallinn and Medellín as part of a single global trading practice Team & Client Management: Own the performance, manage the bandwidth, lead and develop your media buying cluster Coach traders through live optimization decisions to drive self sufficiency and skill growth. Run onboarding and ongoing training for new traders, and act as the escalation point for complex or at-risk campaigns in the cluster. Seamlessly manage team members and their direct communications with clients and other stakeholders, ensuring high-quality standards and timely problem resolution with excellent service. Conduct training for new staff and adjacent stakeholders in client services and sales teams Campaign Strategy & Execution: Serve as the senior trading on our largest accounts and own campaign architecture, bidding strategy, supply strategy, budget pacing and KPI performance. Create and execute client campaigns based on available data, audience segments, creative assets, and required targeting. Liaise with our global media planner to execute comprehensive campaign plans tailored to the nature of each campaign. Drive lower-funnel outcomes across acquisition and retention goals, diagnose CPA and ROAS shortfalls to enhance campaign performance. Analyze recorded data and implement changes, settings, or modifications to improve the efficiency of the clients' inventory serving pattern. Analyze, present, and execute strategic offerings to clients to enhance performance across all media channels. Reporting & Optimization: Review and fully understand client reporting tools and attribution models to ensure accurate optimizations and generate value for clients within the cluster. Create insightful reports for managed campaigns, including in-depth deep dives and recaps for weekly meetings. Leadership Codify modern trading principles into documented playbooks and build processes to support a growing business across clusters. Drive consistency in campaign setup, naming, taxonomy, whitelisting and optimization cadence. WHAT YOU’LL BRING: 4+ years of experience in programmatic media buying, digital advertising, or ad tech, with a strong track record in trading leadership roles. Deep expertise in DSPs, SSPs, ad exchanges, DMPs, and data-driven trading strategies. (TTD, Amazon DSP, Moloco and Beeswax in particular). A demonstrable track record on lower funnel acquisition campaigns - you can walk through an account you turned around and explain exactly what you changed and why. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets and make data-driven decisions. Basic knowledge understanding and experience is social and walled gardens (Meta, Snap, X and Google Ads) Ability to manage accounts with multiple activity types and complex setups (Acquisition, Branding, Retention, etc). Ability to run standard queries to extract data relevant to the managed campaign, provide insights based on the extracted data. Clear and strategic understanding and knowledge of inventory partners and SSPs. Advanced understanding of tagging solutions, ad servers and digital 3 party attribution partners and ability to navigate through the respective environment. Strong understanding of measurement and attribution, specifically ad servers, MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, Kochava), and pixels. Knowledge of internal tools in use with campaign processing such as JIRA, Confluence, PowerBI, and other reporting platforms, etc. Understanding of sports media, gaming, betting, or related industries is a plus. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As the Head of State and Local Government Sales at Anthropic, you'll lead and scale our state and local government sales organization to drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI across state agencies, counties, cities, and other local government entities throughout the United States. You'll leverage your deep understanding of state and local government operations and proven sales leadership expertise to build a high-performing team while establishing strategic relationships with key states, municipalities, and public sector partners. Working closely with GTM, product, and marketing teams, you'll define and execute our go-to-market strategy for the state and local government sector while maintaining the highest standards of security and compliance. Key responsibilities Build, lead, and scale a state and local government sales team, including hiring top talent, setting clear performance expectations, and providing ongoing coaching and development Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies for state and local government, including territory design, market segmentation, competitive positioning, and revenue forecasting across a large and geographically distributed customer base Own overall state and local government revenue targets and ensure team performance against quotas, while providing visibility into pipeline health and deal progression Establish and cultivate relationships with governors' offices, state CIOs, agency executives, and city and county leadership, serving as Anthropic's senior point of contact for strategic engagement while empowering your team to own day-to-day customer relationships Win new business across state and local government by helping state agencies, counties, and cities integrate AI into their technology stacks and constituent-facing and back-office workflows to accelerate delivery and improve service outcomes Establish and refine sales processes, methodologies, and playbooks specific to state and local procurement, including cooperative purchasing agreements, statewide contracts, RFP/RFI processes, and state-specific compliance requirements Build and manage strategic relationships with cloud service providers, system integrators, and resellers to create scalable go-to-market motions across the state and local market Synthesize market feedback and customer insights to inform product roadmap and competitive strategy, working closely with product and marketing teams Partner with legal, compliance, and delivery teams to ensure successful contract execution and customer satisfaction Implement metrics, reporting, and performance management systems to drive team accountability and continuous improvement Represent Anthropic at industry events and with key stakeholders, establishing our brand as the trusted AI partner for state and local government Minimum qualifications 15+ years of enterprise sales experience with 5+ years managing state and local government sales teams, with a proven track record of scaling revenue and building high-performing organizations Deep understanding of state and local government missions, budget and legislative cycles, modernization initiatives, and technology adoption patterns across multiple states and municipalities Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain top sales talent while creating a culture of performance and accountability Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for emerging technologies in the state and local government space Extensive experience with state and local contracting vehicles, cooperative purchasing agreements, procurement mechanisms, and compliance requirements such as StateRAMP, CJIS, and state-specific data privacy standards Strong track record of consistently exceeding team revenue targets and building predictable, scalable sales motions across a high-volume, distributed territory Proven ability to build and manage strategic channel partnerships and ecosystem relationships, including cloud providers, system integrators, and resellers Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across all levels, from technical teams to state CIOs, agency executives, and elected and appointed officials Experience implementing sales methodologies, CRM systems, and performance management processes A passion for safe and ethical AI development, with the ability to articulate its importance in government contexts and build trust with state and local stakeholders Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $550,000 — $700,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

About the role We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across France. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across France, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives. In this role, you will: Drive government adoption and revenue (primary) - Identify government partnership opportunities across France — from healthcare and education to transport, public banks, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products. - Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts. - Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team. Location This role is located in France. items.description: Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. About the opportunity: This is a strategic enterprise sales role for a seasoned seller who knows how to win complex, high-stakes deals. In this role, you aren’t offering incremental solutions, you are delivering the future of financial infrastructure by helping banks build their digital asset strategies from the ground up. By equipping major global institutions with the essential framework to secure and support agentic commerce, you will drive the foundational shift necessary for AI to scale effectively. You’ll own full-cycle sales into Tier 1, 2, and 3 US banks and financial institutions, building relationships with C-suite executives, navigating multi-threaded buying committees, and closing deals that fundamentally transform how these institutions build with digital assets. You’ll work with forward-thinking executives who understand that blockchain and digital assets represent a paradigm shift in how financial services will operate over the coming decades. If you’re someone who gets energized by problem-solving and building deep strategic relationships, this role will challenge you in the best way. You’ll navigate sophisticated stakeholder landscapes, work through rigorous vendor assessments, and ultimately close transformational deals that reshape how banks operate. If you’re motivated by big wins that require strategy, persistence, and executive presence, you’ll thrive here. You’ll partner with world-class talent. You’ll work alongside elite Sales Engineers who can go deep technically, collaborate with a best-in-class marketing and SDR team, and have direct access to our executive team. This is a team-selling environment where everyone is committed to winning together. What you’ll do: Own and execute full-cycle sales into US banks and financial institutions Build and manage a robust pipeline through strategic prospecting, executive networking, and thoughtful account planning Navigate multi-stakeholder sales processes involving Treasury, Custody, Global Markets, Compliance, Legal, Risk, InfoSec, and Technology teams Partner with Sales Engineers to deliver compelling technical discovery and demos Leverage our partner ecosystem (cloud providers, systems integrators) to accelerate deals and expand your reach Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting and represent your business with precision Consistently deliver against annual quota What you bring: Enterprise sales mastery. You have 5+ years selling complex SaaS or institutional solutions into banks, financial institutions, or highly regulated industries. Deep financial services acumen. You understand how banks work; not just the org chart, but how Treasury, Custody, Payments, and Capital Markets functions operate. You know how to speak the language of banking executives and understand their strategic priorities. Hunter DNA. You’re energized by prospecting and building your own pipeline. You don’t wait for leads to come to you; you identify target accounts, craft strategic outreach, build executive relationships, and create opportunities where others see closed doors. Technical curiosity and aptitude. You can learn technical products quickly and translate infrastructure capabilities into business outcomes. You’re comfortable partnering with technical teams and holding your own in conversations about security, compliance, and architecture. Strategic persistence. You understand that the best deals take time. You know how to maintain momentum through long cycles, navigate setbacks, and keep multiple stakeholders engaged. Genuine passion for this market. You’re intellectually curious about blockchain, digital assets, and the future of financial services. You don’t need to be a crypto native, but you’re genuinely excited to be at the forefront of how this technology will reshape banking over the next decade. Ideal background includes: Track record of overachievement (110%+ to quota consistently) Experience selling cybersecurity, infrastructure, fintech, or payments solutions Familiarity with co-sell motions through technology partners (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft) Experience working with Sales Engineers in technical sales environments We have a comprehensive onboarding and training program for all new employees. items.description: We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. Driving profitable growth through commercial intelligence, structural rigor & strategic steering ABOUT US As the market leader in sports technology, Sportradar (NASDAQ: SRAD) is positioned at the center of the sports ecosystem. Our broader Financial Planning & Analysis organization plays a critical role in delivering extraordinary growth; we’re targeting a 15% CAGR for revenue while consistently expanding margin and cash conversion. In an industry where AI is redefining fan engagement, our finance leaders must be as sophisticated as our technology: combining financial discipline with commercial acumen and advanced analytics to unlock opportunities across a market growing at double-digit percent annually. THE CHALLANGE Reporting to the VP of Revenue Performance & Planning, you are the primary performance auditor of commercial outcomes. You don't just report numbers; you interrogate them and recommend the way forward to maximize value. Your mission is to identify the "why" behind performance trends that you package to a compelling story to drive a business decision. You provide the critical challenge required for driving revenue and margin, guiding business counterparts through a transformative planning process that prioritizes drivers over pure outcomes. Proactive revenue performance analysis: move past outcomes to identify the specific revenue drivers (e.g., usage, churn, pricing, market) that management must focus on. Revenue forecast pressure-testing: Interrogate the inputs that feed our global P&L to ensure every forecast is achievable and rooted in actionable drivers. Logic refinement: Identify and dismantle broken assumptions in commercial plans and rebuild them into actionable, robust frameworks. Causal synthesis: Translate complex technical and commercial data into clear, authoritative narratives for senior stakeholders. Key responsibilities Driver autopsy: Conduct deep-dives into revenue beats or misses to distinguish between one-time windfalls and core structural trends. Planning guidance: Lead commercial counterparts through the forecasting and budgeting process to ensure submissions are robust and logically sound. Business modeling: Create elegant solutions for complex business topics like pricing elasticity and market entry costs. Build automated revenue reporting using advanced analytical and reporting tools on top of data warehouse and billing data sets to steer commercial decision making ABOUT YOU You ask smart questions and refuse to accept surface-level explanations. You enable business success by providing the "so-what" that others miss. You are a "fixer" who enjoys the challenge of untangling messy data problems to find a clear path forward. What we're looking for Experience : 5-8 years in a multidisciplinary finance, analytics, and/or consulting role. Archetype : We seek high proficiency in either commercial finance or commercial analytics. Education : MBA or relevant master’s degree preferred. Technical requirement : SQL, Power BI / Tableau, and AI agents knowledge is essential. Experience with Python or n8n/workflow automation is highly valued. Mindset : An "accountability" mindset - you value the strength of a plan over the speed of its delivery. At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

We operate as one cohesive, globally distributed team building infrastructure that pushes crypto forward. UMA’s Optimistic Oracle records verifiable truth onto blockchains. Exchanges, brokerages, sportsbooks, fintech platforms, and trading venues are increasingly exploring how prediction markets can power new products and experiences. We believe UMA is uniquely positioned to become the infrastructure layer powering this shift. We're looking for a senior commercial leader who can build strategic relationships with sophisticated institutions, navigate complex technical and regulatory conversations, and help bring new enterprise partnerships to life. This is not a traditional high-volume sales role. Success in this position will come from deeply understanding a small number of high-value opportunities, building trust with senior decision makers, and helping shape solutions that meet both customer and market needs. You'll work directly with leadership and have significant influence over how UMA expands into this emerging category. Prior prediction market experience is not required. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own a focused portfolio of high-value enterprise opportunities from initial outreach through commercial close and long-term expansion - Build trusted relationships with sophisticated institutional counterparties - Lead commercial and technical conversations with business, product, engineering, and executive stakeholders - Translate customer requirements into actionable product feedback for internal teams - Partner closely with product, engineering, legal, and leadership teams to navigate technical diligence, compliance considerations, and commercial structuring - Drive enterprise integrations from early technical scoping through launch - Help shape UMA's enterprise go-to-market strategy - Represent Risk Labs at strategic industry events, conferences, and partnership discussions - Help establish UMA as the preferred oracle infrastructure provider for institutional prediction market applications WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR CORE REQUIREMENTS - 7+ years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, business development, technical commercial roles, or similar - Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals with sophisticated institutional buyers - Experience managing long sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders - Strong technical fluency and comfort discussing APIs, integrations, technical products, and infrastructure - Excellent executive communication skills - Strong product judgment and ability to translate customer needs into clear product direction - Ability to operate independently and thrive in ambiguous environments NICE TO HAVE - Experience working with financial institutions, exchanges, brokers, trading firms, sportsbooks, fintech infrastructure providers, or other regulated market participants - Familiarity with US market regulation and institutional trading environments - Experience navigating enterprise compliance, procurement, and legal processes - Comfort reading API documentation and reasoning about technical systems - Exposure to blockchain infrastructure, oracle systems, prediction markets, or crypto-native products YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU'VE WORKED IN - Financial infrastructure - Market data - Trading technology - Exchange technology - Brokerage platforms - Sports betting - Enterprise fintech - Capital markets - Blockchain infrastructure We are particularly interested in candidates who have built relationships with regulated institutions and know how to navigate complex commercial environments. SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE Within your first 12 months, success may look like: - Closing multiple strategic institutional partnerships - Generating meaningful revenue growth for UMA - Bringing enterprise integrations live - Helping shape UMA's product roadmap through direct customer insight - Expanding UMA's footprint across prediction markets and adjacent financial infrastructure categories WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Prediction markets are becoming an increasingly important part of the future financial ecosystem. Risk Labs is helping build the infrastructure layer that powers this shift. The person in this role will help define how exchanges, brokerages, sportsbooks, trading platforms, and other institutional participants engage with prediction markets in the years ahead. This is a rare opportunity to help shape a new category while working directly with company leadership and some of the most sophisticated organizations in financial markets. If you're excited about this role, even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Risk Labs is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status. OUR VALUES We value curiosity. items.title: Account Manager - Japan
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE This role partners directly with enterprise customers building and deploying conversational agents on the ElevenLabs Agents Platform. The focus is hands-on execution - advising on agent design, personas, conversation flows, tool integrations, and voice customization to deliver clear business outcomes in production environments. You will guide customers through best practices for deploying and scaling agents across web, mobile, and telephony, and for integrating agents with existing data sources and systems. You will analyze agent performance data and conversational logs to identify friction points and optimization opportunities that improve accuracy, user experience, and reliability at scale. In parallel, you will own expansion outcomes across a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts. Success is measured by net revenue retention and sustained multi-product adoption. You will identify expansion opportunities, drive cross-sell through deeper agent usage, and partner with Sales, Engineering, and Account Managers to convert technical success into durable revenue growth and long-term customer commitment. REQUIREMENTS - 5-7 years of Customer Success or Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in Japan - Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents - Familiarity and experience with API Integrations, and comfort and knowledge of navigating SDKs - Proven experience driving revenue outcomes, including owning a revenue quota and identifying, qualifying, and closing cross-sell opportunities - Excellent problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills to address customer needs and concerns - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with customers at all levels of an organization - Strong understanding of the Japan market landscape and cultural nuances - Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote or distributed team environment #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: Work with the Best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold – concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network Orderly's affiliate manager is responsible for building and managing a company's affiliate program, including recruiting new affiliates, maintaining relationships with existing ones, and negotiating contracts: What will you be working on? Maintain a deep, up-to-date understanding of the affiliate marketing landscape, including industry trends, emerging technologies, and key players in the crypto and blockchain space. Identify, source, and onboard the right set of affiliate partners to align with the company's product goals and business strategy. Build, maintain, and grow strong relationships with top affiliates globally, ensuring long-term partnerships and mutual success. Manage and optimize relationships with existing affiliates and clients, ensuring consistent performance and alignment with business objectives. Collaborate with affiliate partners and internal teams to design and implement campaigns; work closely with Product and Engineering teams to address affiliate needs and ensure seamless integration and execution. Who will you be working with? Maintain close collaboration with the Marketing , Operations , Product , and Business Development teams to ensure cohesive strategies and streamlined processes. About you The ability to build relationships and manage a diverse community The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data Proficiency in Microsoft Excel Knowledge of affiliate networks Exceptional planning and project management skills Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well.
